summary: Constructor/initializer that writes sentinel defaults into seven dword fields of the pointed object: -1 at offsets 0x0, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18 and 0x1C, -1.0 (stored as -1082130432) at 0x8, and 0 at 0xC. Returns the constant -1. No reads, no globals, no branches, no calls.

local_names.result: return value register carrying the constant -1

operations.description: Write -1 into the dword at offset 0x0 of the object.
Write the float -1.0 (bit pattern stored as the dword -1082130432) into the dword at offset 0x8.
Write 0 into the dword at offset 0xC.
Write -1 into the dword at offset 0x10.
Write -1 into the dword at offset 0x14.
Write -1 into the dword at offset 0x18.
Write -1 into the dword at offset 0x1C.
Return the constant -1 (the same value written into the first field).

unresolved: The type of the pointed object is unknown; owner is UnknownObject.
Semantic meaning of each sentinel field (-1 dwords, -1.0f float, zero dword) is unknown.
Dword at offset 0x4 (this[1]) is deliberately not initialized by this function.
